title: Imported Squarespace product photos load on Shop cards instead of showing a broken image
detail: Owner screenshot 2026-10-20 (The Group Spotlight editor): the four Shop link cards showed broken image icons. THE CAUSE, read from the database: commerce_products.images for those products hold images.squarespace-cdn.com URLs (the Squarespace import keeps the original CDN address), and next/image refuses any host not in next.config.ts images.remotePatterns, so the optimizer returned an error for every one. THE FIX: list images.squarespace-cdn.com (path /content/**) in remotePatterns, which repairs the Link cards, the market and every other next/image consumer of those photos. Next: the transparent top bar from the same screenshot.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('next.config.ts','utf8');if(!s.includes('images.squarespace-cdn.com')){console.error('LIVE-1067: Squarespace CDN is not an allowed image host');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the Squarespace CDN host leaves images.remotePatterns, which breaks every imported product photo.
